tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description:
Retrieves user profile information from Tradier account.
Returns:
    Map: User profile details including:
        - User ID
        - Account information
        - Profile settings

tools.name: place_equity_order
tools.description:
Places an equity order (buy/sell stock).
Parameters:
    account_number: Account to place order in
    symbol: Stock symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
    side: "buy" or "sell"
    quantity: Number of shares
    type: Order type ("market", "limit", "stop", "stop_limit")
    duration: Order duration ("day", "gtc", "pre", "post")
    price: Price for limit orders (optional)
    stop: Stop price for stop orders (optional)
Returns:
    Map: Order confirmation with order ID and details

tools.name: get_market_quotes
tools.description:
Retrieves market quotes for specified symbols.
Parameters:
    symbols: Comma-separated list of symbols (e.g., "AAPL,GOOGL,MSFT")
Returns:
    Map: Quote details including:
        - Symbol
        - Last price
        - Change
        - Percent change
        - Volume
        - Bid/Ask

tools.name: get_watchlists
tools.description:
Retrieves all watchlists for the user.
Returns:
    Map: List of watchlists with their symbols

tools.name: get_account_balances
tools.description:
Retrieves account balance information for a specific account.
Parameters:
    account_number: The account number to get balances for
Returns:
    Map: Balance details including:
        - Total equity
        - Option buying power
        - Stock buying power
        - Cash available
        - Day trading buying power
        - Dividend balance

tools.name: get_gainloss
tools.description:
Retrieves gain/loss report for an account.
Parameters:
    account_number: Account to get report for
    page (optional): Page number for pagination
    limit (optional): Number of records per page
Returns:
    Map: Gain/loss report with realized and unrealized P&L

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description:
Retrieves orders for a specific account.
Parameters:
    account_number: The account number to get orders for
Returns:
    Map: Order details including:
        - Order ID
        - Symbol
        - Side (buy/sell)
        - Quantity
        - Price
        - Order type
        - Status
        - Date created

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description:
Cancels an existing order.
Parameters:
    account_number: Account containing the order
    order_id: ID of the order to cancel
Returns:
    Map: Cancellation confirmation

tools.name: get_account_history
tools.description:
Retrieves historical activity for an account including trades, dividends, options, transfers, and other transactions.
Parameters:
    account_number: The account number to get history for (required)
    page: Page number for paginated results (optional, default: 1)
    limit: Number of results to return per page (optional, default: 25, max: 100)
    type: Activity type filter (optional) - trade, option, ach, wire, dividend, fee, tax, journal, check, transfer, adjustment, interest
    start: Start date in yyyy-mm-dd format (optional, default: account opening date)
    end: End date in yyyy-mm-dd format (optional, default: end of current day)
    symbol: Filter by security symbol (optional)
    exact_match: Use exact symbol match (optional, default: false)
Returns:
    Map: Account history including:
        - event array with amount, date, type, and transaction details
        - trade details (commission, description, price, quantity, symbol, trade_type)
        - option details (option_type, description, quantity)
        - journal details (description, quantity)
        - dividend details (description, quantity, symbol)

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.description:
Adds symbols to a watchlist.
Parameters:
    watchlist_id: ID of the watchlist
    symbols: Comma-separated list of symbols to add
Returns:
    Map: Confirmation of symbols added

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description:
Retrieves current positions for a specific account.
Parameters:
    account_number: The account number to get positions for
Returns:
    Map: Position details including:
        - Symbol
        - Quantity
        - Cost basis
        - Date acquired
        - Current value

tools.name: get_market_calendar
tools.description:
Retrieves market calendar information showing trading days and holidays.
Parameters:
    month (optional): Month in MM format (e.g., "12" for December)
    year (optional): Year in YYYY format (e.g., "2024")
Returns:
    Map: Market calendar information

tools.name: get_account_historical_balances
tools.description:
Retrieves historical account balance information for a specific account.
Parameters:
    account_number: The account number to get balances for
    period: The period for which to fetch balances
            (WEEK, MONTH, YEAR, YEAR_5, YEAR_10, YTD, ALL)
Returns:
    Map: Historical balances including:
        - date (String)
        - value (Double)
        - delta (Double)
        - delta_percent (Double)

tools.name: get_historical_data
tools.description:
Retrieves historical price data for a symbol.
Parameters:
    symbol: Symbol to get data for
    interval: Data interval ("daily", "weekly", "monthly")
    start (optional): Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
    end (optional): End date in YYYY-MM-DD format
Returns:
    Map: Historical price data with OHLCV information

tools.name: place_multileg_option_order
tools.description:
Places a multileg option order (spreads, straddles, etc.).
Parameters:
    account_number: Account to place order in
    symbol: Underlying symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
    type: Order type ("market", "debit", "credit", "even")
    duration: Order duration ("day", "gtc")
    price: Price for limit orders (optional, required for debit/credit)
    leg1_option_symbol: Option symbol for first leg (e.g., "AAPL250321C00150000")
    leg1_side: Side for first leg ("buy_to_open", "buy_to_close", "sell_to_open", "sell_to_close")
    leg1_quantity: Quantity for first leg
    leg2_option_symbol: Option symbol for second leg
    leg2_side: Side for second leg
    leg2_quantity: Quantity for second leg
    leg3_option_symbol: Option symbol for third leg (optional)
    leg3_side: Side for third leg (optional)
    leg3_quantity: Quantity for third leg (optional)
    leg4_option_symbol: Option symbol for fourth leg (optional)
    leg4_side: Side for fourth leg (optional)
    leg4_quantity: Quantity for fourth leg (optional)
Returns:
    Map: Order confirmation with order ID and details

tools.name: get_options_chain
tools.description:
Retrieves options chain for a given symbol and expiration date.
Parameters:
    symbol: Underlying symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
    expiration: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format
    greeks (optional): Include Greeks calculation if asked (true/false, default: false)
Returns:
    Map: Options chain with strike prices, premiums, and Greeks if requested

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description:
Retrieves company profile information for one or more stock symbols.
Parameters:
    symbols (String): Comma-separated stock symbols (e.g., "AAPL" or "AAPL,MSFT,JNJ")
Returns:
    List of Maps: Company profile details for each symbol including:
        - symbol: Stock symbol
        - longSummary: Summary of the company
        - website: Company website

tools.name: place_oco_order
tools.description:
Places an OCO (One-Cancels-Other) order - two orders where if one executes, the other is cancelled.
Requirements:
    - Different order types required for each leg
    - If both are equities, symbol must match
    - If both are options, option_symbol must match
    - Duration must match if specified per leg
Parameters:
    account_number: Account to place order in
    order1_class: Order class for first order ("equity" or "option")
    order1_symbol: Symbol for first order
    order1_option_symbol: Option symbol for first order (required if class is "option")
    order1_side: Side for first order ("buy", "sell", "buy_to_open", etc.)
    order1_quantity: Quantity for first order
    order1_type: Order type for first order ("market", "limit", "stop", "stop_limit")
    order1_duration: Duration for first order ("day", "gtc")
    order1_price: Price for first order (optional)
    order1_stop: Stop price for first order (optional)
    order2_class: Order class for second order
    order2_symbol: Symbol for second order (must match order1_symbol for equities)
    order2_option_symbol: Option symbol for second order (must match order1_option_symbol for options)
    order2_side: Side for second order
    order2_quantity: Quantity for second order
    order2_type: Order type for second order (must be different from order1_type)
    order2_duration: Duration for second order
    order2_price: Price for second order (optional)
    order2_stop: Stop price for second order (optional)
Returns:
    Map: Order confirmation with order IDs and details

tools.name: place_oto_order
tools.description:
Places an OTO (One-Triggers-Other) order - first order must execute before second order is submitted.
Parameters:
    account_number: Account to place order in
    order1_class: Order class for first order ("equity" or "option")
    order1_symbol: Symbol for first order
    order1_option_symbol: Option symbol for first order (required if class is "option")
    order1_side: Side for first order ("buy", "sell", "buy_to_open", etc.)
    order1_quantity: Quantity for first order
    order1_type: Order type for first order ("market", "limit", "stop", "stop_limit")
    order1_duration: Duration for first order ("day", "gtc")
    order1_price: Price for first order (optional)
    order1_stop: Stop price for first order (optional)
    order2_class: Order class for second (triggered) order
    order2_symbol: Symbol for second order
    order2_option_symbol: Option symbol for second order (required if class is "option")
    order2_side: Side for second order
    order2_quantity: Quantity for second order
    order2_type: Order type for second order
    order2_duration: Duration for second order
    order2_price: Price for second order (optional)
    order2_stop: Stop price for second order (optional)
Returns:
    Map: Order confirmation with order IDs and details

tools.name: place_option_order
tools.description:
Places an options order.
Parameters:
    account_number: Account to place order in
    symbol: Underlying symbol (e.g., "AAPL")
    option_symbol: Full option symbol (e.g., "AAPL032024C00150000")
    side: "buy_to_open", "buy_to_close", "sell_to_open", "sell_to_close"
    quantity: Number of contracts
    type: Order type ("market", "limit", "stop", "stop_limit")
    duration: Order duration ("day", "gtc", "pre", "post")
    price: Price for limit orders (optional)
Returns:
    Map: Order confirmation with order ID and details

tools.name: place_otoco_order
tools.description:
Places an OTOCO (One-Triggers-One-Cancels-Other) order - first order triggers two additional orders where one cancels the other.
Requirements:
    - Order 2 and 3 must have matching symbols (equities) or option_symbols (options)
    - Order 2 and 3 must have different types
    - Matching duration if specified per leg
Parameters:
    account_number: Account to place order in
    order1_class: Order class for first (trigger) order ("equity" or "option")
    order1_symbol: Symbol for first order
    order1_option_symbol: Option symbol for first order (required if class is "option")
    order1_side: Side for first order
    order1_quantity: Quantity for first order
    order1_type: Order type for first order
    order1_duration: Duration for first order ("day", "gtc")
    order1_price: Price for first order (optional)
    order1_stop: Stop price for first order (optional)
    order2_class: Order class for second (triggered) order
    order2_symbol: Symbol for second order
    order2_option_symbol: Option symbol for second order
    order2_side: Side for second order
    order2_quantity: Quantity for second order
    order2_type: Order type for second order
    order2_duration: Duration for second order
    order2_price: Price for second order (optional)
    order2_stop: Stop price for second order (optional)
    order3_class: Order class for third (triggered) order
    order3_symbol: Symbol for third order (must match order2_symbol)
    order3_option_symbol: Option symbol for third order (must match order2_option_symbol)
    order3_side: Side for third order
    order3_quantity: Quantity for third order
    order3_type: Order type for third order (must be different from order2_type)
    order3_duration: Duration for third order
    order3_price: Price for third order (optional)
    order3_stop: Stop price for third order (optional)
Returns:
    Map: Order confirmation with order IDs and details
